_note: The twelve columns of the committee table. 'ask' is what the extractor must find; it is the same text the page shows as the column definition.

terms.label: Parties and buyer credit standing
terms.ask: Seller and Buyer by legal name; any guarantor of the Buyer and the instrument (parent company guarantee, rating trigger).

terms.label: Facility: technology, capacity, location
terms.ask: Technology, installed capacity in MW (AC and DC where both are given), site, municipality or region, country, bidding zone.

terms.label: Supply period and its start
terms.ask: Length of the supply or delivery term in years and the event or date it starts from.

terms.label: Commercial operation date, longstop and delay damages
terms.ask: Target commercial operation date, longstop date, delay liquidated damages per day and their cap.

terms.label: Contract price and indexation
terms.ask: The price per MWh (or strike price), where in the document it is stated, and any indexation or escalation with its start date and share.

terms.label: Volume structure, expected production and performance guarantee
terms.ask: Pay-as-produced or fixed volume, contract quantity, expected annual production (P50), minimum or availability guarantee and its remedy.

terms.label: Product and certificates
terms.ask: What is sold: electricity, guarantees of origin (amount, cost), capacity or other attributes.

terms.label: Curtailment: who may curtail, cap, deemed delivery
terms.ask: Who may curtail the facility, any cap in hours or MWh, whether curtailed energy is paid as deemed delivered, treatment of grid-operator curtailment and negative prices.

terms.label: Delivery point, settlement type and balancing responsibility
terms.ask: Physical or financial settlement, delivery point, reference price if financial, who is balance responsible and bears imbalance cost.

terms.label: Credit support from each party
terms.ask: Instrument, amount and duration of the credit support given by the Seller and by the Buyer.

terms.label: Events of default, termination and termination amount
terms.ask: Main events of default and how the termination amount is calculated. If the calculation is only referenced to a document that is not attached, the amount is not found.

terms.label: Change in law and force majeure allocation
terms.ask: Who bears the cost of a change in law, any threshold or renegotiation right, and the force majeure duration that gives a termination right. Read the meaning, not the heading: the allocation may sit under taxes or regulatory costs.
